Feign,Ⓒv. t.ⒹmanasA kxp c. or sfj 6 P.
Ⓑ
 2 kapawaM-vyAjaM-Cadma kf 8 U; apa-diS 6 P; ‘f(eign)ing illness’ SarIrAsvAsTyamapadiSya; oft. ex. by kftaka, kftrima, or kapawa-vyAja-Cadma-miTyA in comp.; ‘he f(eign)ed himself to be dead’ AtmAnaM mftavatsaMdarSayAmAsa; ‘f(eign)ing anger’ kftakaM kopaM kftvA; ‘f(eign)ing sleep’ prasuptalakzaRa, vyAjasupta, lakzasupta.
Ⓝ[Feign]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹvyAja-kapawa-Cadma miTyA in comp.; kUwArTa, kalpita, kftaka, kftrima; ‘f(eigned) quarrel’ kftaka-kaMlahaH, ‘a f(eigned) dress’ kapawaveSaH; ‘f(eigned) sleep’ vyAjanidrA; ‘a f(eigned) ascetic’ CadmatApasaH.
Ⓝ[Feign]edly, [Feign]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹmiTyA, sakapawaM, savyAjaM, CadmanA.
Ⓝ[Feign]er,Ⓒs.ⒹkApawikaH, Cadmin m., pratArakaH; ‘f(eigner) of illness’ AturaliMgin.
